key_insight: VOSR shows that a super-resolution model trained solely on visual LR–HR data can match or rival generative SR methods that adapt large text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models, questioning the need for text-conditioned pretraining for SR.
problem_solved: Reduces dependence on massive web-scale text–image pretraining and the mismatch between generic T2I generators and the LR-conditioned image restoration task, enabling SR models that are specialized, data-efficient, and free of text-conditioning biases.
method: Introduce a vision-only generative framework (VOSR) trained purely on visual LR–HR pairs rather than T2I-pretrained weights.
Condition the generative model directly on the low-resolution input so it learns restoration-specific priors tailored to SR.
Replace text-conditioning and large T2I adaptation with focused visual supervision to achieve comparable generative SR performance.
impact: Demonstrates a practical alternative to heavy T2I adaptation for SR, allowing practitioners to build more compact, targeted, and less biased super-resolution models that are easier to train and deploy in image-restoration pipelines.

paper_title: VOSR: A Vision-Only Generative Model for Image Super-Resolution
paper_authors: Rongyuan Wu, Lingchen Sun, Zhengqiang Zhang, Xiangtao Kong, Jixin Zhao
